This vignette shows how to use geometry primitives and ggplot2-based plotting helpers in tidyrethinking.

## Setup

```{r}
library(tidyrethinking)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

## 1. Circles and wedges

```{r}
circ <- circle_points(center = c(0, 0), r = 1, n = 200)
wed  <- wedge_polygon(center = c(0, 0), r = 1, theta_start = 0, theta_end = pi/3, n = 50)

p <- ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(data = wed, aes(x, y), fill = "gold", color = NA, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_path(data = circ,  aes(x, y), color = "black") +
  coord_equal() + theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Circle with wedge")
p
```

## 2. Lines with outlines and reference lines

```{r}
df <- tibble::tibble(x = c(0, 1), y = c(0, 1))
lines_with_outline(df, outline_color = "white", line_color = "black", linewidth = 1.2, outline_width = 0.8) +
  abline_with_outline(a = 0.2, b = 0.8, xlim = c(0, 1), color = "red", outline_color = "white") +
  theme_minimal() + labs(title = "Outlined line and abline")
```
